milestone.title: CPD skill consolidation: 4 skills → 3, drop master-planner + mp-handoff + mp-code-review

intent.outcome: The shipped skill surface for CPD is 3 skills: mp-flow (base — mp usage, the 12-stage timeline, hand-off protocol, L5), mp-runner (role-specific — execute + fix), mp-coordinator (role-specific — plan + review + adversarial). spec-grill remains as an adversarial sub-mode reference. master-planner, mp-handoff, and mp-code-review are no longer shipped. The install surface (harness.rs, install.rs) is updated to match. A fresh session that says 'execute milestone M134' loads mp-flow + mp-runner; one that says 'groom M134' loads mp-flow + mp-coordinator; one that says 'what's the next milestone?' loads mp-flow.

problem.description: M119–M123 shipped 4 role-relevant skill directories (mp-flow, mp-handoff, mp-runner, mp-coordinator) plus 2 sub-mode tools (master-planner, spec-grill). M121 was titled 'master-planner + spec-grill + mp-code-review sub-mode integration' but the user's dogfooding of CPD on the running TUI milestones (M134–M140) and on the rc-version of M119–M123 surfaced three real frictions: (1) master-planner duplicates mp-coordinator/planning.md content (the SKILL.md cross-link says 'see mp-coordinator/planning.md' and planning.md says 'see master-planner' — a single-source-invariant violation that costs a read per context switch); (2) mp-handoff is a 4-contract file but mp-flow already says 'handoffs (deep-dive in M123)' — the user wants handoffs baked into the base flow, not a separate skill to load; (3) mp-code-review is too personal — each operator runs a different review lens and shipping one centralizes opinion. The current install surface (crates/mp/src/harness.rs:25-103, install.rs:366-491) hard-codes master-planner as a special-cased path in 8 harness entries; this leaks the planning-tool's name into every harness adapter and complicates the install tests (install.rs:778-819). Consolidating to 3 skills is a structural cleanup that pays for itself the next time the team reorganizes.

in_scope: Fold master-planner's content into templates/skills/mp-coordinator/planning.md so the planning sub-mode becomes self-contained (no back-link to a separate skill). Update planning.md to remove 'see master-planner' references; inline the relevant planning guidance. Keep spec-grill as a sub-mode reference (M121 already does this; no change to that path).

Fold mp-handoff's content — the 4 hand-off contracts (coordinator→runner Approve→Claim, runner→coordinator Complete→External, coordinator→runner Review→Remediate, runner→coordinator Remediate→Re-review), L5 session-boundary rule, and hand-off field shape — into templates/skills/mp-flow/SKILL.md. Add a 'Hand-off protocol' section. The 4 contracts become a single table with the data-passed columns that mp-flow already half-shows.
Update mp-flow/SKILL.md and flow-stages.md to remove 'deep-dive in M123' and 'see mp-handoff' back-links; the deep-dive is now inline.

Update templates/skills/mp-coordinator/reviewing.md to remove the mp-code-review reference (currently at line referencing 'mp-code-review' as a sub-skill). Replace with a direct back-link to docs/code-review-lessons.md — the lessons doc is the source of truth per M121's out_of_scope[3]. The reviewing sub-mode reads the lessons doc directly; the operator brings their own review lens.

Remove the special-cased master-planner paths in crates/mp/src/harness.rs (8 harness entries: agents, opencode, cursor, claude, gemini, codex, windsurf, cline, pi) — the install surface is now driven entirely by templates/skills/* directories and the registry, not by hard-coded skill names.

Update crates/mp/src/install.rs to remove master-planner special-casing (5+ references at lines 366, 395, 451, 478, 489, 491, 659, 665) and to update the install registry to ship 3 skills: mp-flow, mp-runner, mp-coordinator. spec-grill stays as an optional install (sub-mode).

Update crates/mp/tests/coordinator_role_skill.rs:63-70 — the test currently asserts reviewing.md contains 'mp-code-review'. Replace with an assertion that reviewing.md references docs/code-review-lessons.md (the source of truth) and that no shipped skill depends on mp-code-review.

Update crates/mp/src/doctor.rs:131-140 — the doctor check 'master-planner skill available' is removed; replaced with a generic 'CPD skill set installed (mp-flow, mp-runner, mp-coordinator)' check that reads templates/skills/* and asserts the 3 expected directories exist.
Update AGENTS.md (root) and master-plan/AGENTS.md references that mention master-planner, mp-handoff, or mp-code-review. Run a repo-wide grep for these terms; replace or remove as appropriate.
Update cpd/mp-flow.md (Obsidian vault) to reflect the 3-skill architecture. Update cpd/master-plan-adaptations.md section 5 (Coordinator/Runner role surface) accordingly.

Tests: mp install --skills mp-flow,mp-runner,mp-coordinator deploys the 3 skills to all 8 harness directories. mp validate --summary is clean. make mp-flow-lint passes. mp install --check asserts the 3-skill registry is consistent (no dangling references to master-planner, mp-handoff, or mp-code-review).

Manual verification: in a fresh agent session, say 'execute milestone M134' — confirm mp-flow + mp-runner are loaded. Say 'groom M134' — confirm mp-flow + mp-coordinator are loaded. Say 'what are the next milestones?' — confirm mp-flow is loaded. Auto-loading is the harness's job; the skill files declare their purpose and trigger phrases clearly enough to match.
out_of_scope: Renaming mp CLI commands or milestone vocabulary (per user decision: keep current terminology; CPD is the theory, mp is the implementation, vocabulary stays)
Restructuring the 12-stage timeline or the 4 hand-off contracts (the contracts move into mp-flow but their content is unchanged)
Authoring the lesson-pattern blocks for L6/L8/L13/L14/L15 in docs/code-review-lessons.md (deferred per M121 out_of_scope[3]; out of scope for the consolidation refactor)
Building a pluggable code-review skill extension point (the user wants personal code-review skills to live outside the repo entirely; no extension point in the install surface)
Changing the mp agent role dispatch (M119 ships the role token; the dispatch stays — only the skill list it loads changes from 4 to 3)
Updating the harness adapters' skill discovery beyond removing master-planner (the harness adapters stay as-is in shape; just stop special-casing the deleted skill)
Auto-loading behavior itself — that's the harness's job. The milestone ships skill files that are clear about purpose and trigger phrases; matching is the harness's responsibility
